blocks.text: Sept. 14, 2026 | Prime Minister Mark Carney announces plans to generate billions by opening Canada's four biggest airports to private investors. The Liberals lean on Stephen Harper to close their big investment summit. And, Nova Scotia families speak out after a funeral home mixes up their loved ones' remains.
